trust_boundary: reviewed external request/first-response attribution; digest alone is not authentication
timestamp_rule: started_at <= captured_at <= checked_at; timezone required; no implicit clock skew

outcomes.resolved: verified billing projection appended; campaign dispatch not authorized
outcomes.already_resolved: same existing proof replayed; no additional network read
outcomes.unknown: null cost; full original reservation retained; append evidence and retry only GET recovery
outcomes.blocked: invalid private path/binding/orphan/ledger integrity; no automatic replacement

capture_digest_rule: sha256(payer.canonical(capture)); base64 fields retain exact request and first-response bytes
